description: Bash wrapper that compiles scripts/forbid-runtime-fmt.rs with rustc and runs it across crates/{vb_core,vb_runtime,vb_storage,vb_ipc}/**/*.rs. Models scripts/check-removed-feature-residue.sh (rustc, not clippy-driver) and scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.sh (4-crate scope). Reports RUNTIME-FMT file:line findings for serde_json|serde_yaml|hyper|reqwest|axum|HashMap<String,_>|tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded patterns. Exits 0 if active findings == 0, exits 1 otherwise. Excludes test/diagnostic/proof code via a cold-markers allowlist copied from check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.rs (lines 7-23). Used by .moon/tasks/forbid-runtime-fmt.yml::forbid-runtime-fmt.
test_impact: Drives test-forbid-runtime-fmt.sh and is the surface under test_quarantine_gate_blocks_json_import, test_quarantine_gate_blocks_unbounded_channel, test_moon_ci_quarantine_dependency_correctly_ordered.

description: Holzman-compliant Rust scanner (compiled by scripts/forbid-runtime-fmt.sh with rustc --edition=2024). Detects active residue of forbidden runtime dependencies/patterns in the four hot crates. Distinguishes test code (#[cfg(test)], dev-dep only paths) from production code via a cold-markers list (diagnostic|fixture|kani|loom|proof|proptest|test_util|tests|verification) to avoid false positives on legitimate test fixtures such as crates/vb_core/tests/proptest_serde_roundtrip.rs. Reports RUNTIME-FMT: <reason>: <file:line>: <text> per finding. Exits 0 if active findings == 0, exits 1 otherwise. Self-skips its own file path and the wrapper path. Models scripts/check-removed-feature-residue.rs (12.1 KB) and scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.rs (920 lines) precedent.
test_impact: Scanner correctness is exercised by fixtures/forbid-runtime-fmt/{positive.rs, negative.rs, negative_unbounded_channel.rs} via test-forbid-runtime-fmt.sh.

description: Bash self-test for the residue-quarantine gate. Models scripts/test-check-removed-crate-residue.sh (165 lines) and scripts/test-check-removed-feature-residue.sh. Drives scripts/forbid-runtime-fmt.sh against positive + negative + real-repo fixtures and asserts: (1) test_quarantine_gate_blocks_json_import — a fixture containing `use serde_json;` (or equivalent) in a hot crate path produces exit 1 and a RUNTIME-FMT: file:line finding; (2) test_quarantine_gate_blocks_unbounded_channel — a fixture containing `tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel()` produces exit 1 and a RUNTIME-FMT: finding; (3) test_moon_ci_quarantine_dependency_correctly_ordered — .moon/tasks/all.yml (or .moon.yml + .moon/tasks/forbid-runtime-fmt.yml) has the new gate declared as a deps: of the :check task and ordered before the heavier compile gates. Self-test exits 0 on success, 1 on any failed assertion.
test_impact: This script IS the test impact for the gate; it is the executable that proves the three test names from the bead description (test_quarantine_gate_blocks_json_import, test_quarantine_gate_blocks_unbounded_channel, test_moon_ci_quarantine_dependency_correctly_ordered) pass.

description: Positive fixture: a clean Rust snippet that does NOT contain any of the banned tokens (serde_json|serde_yaml|hyper|reqwest|axum|HashMap<String,_>|tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded) in non-test code. The gate must report zero active findings and exit 0. Mirrors fixtures/removed-crate-residue/positive.md (18 lines).
test_impact: Used by test-forbid-runtime-fmt.sh [1/N] positive fixture must PASS assertion.

description: Negative fixture: a Rust snippet deliberately contaminated with `use serde_json;` (and/or `use serde_yaml;`, `use hyper;`, `use reqwest;`, `use axum;`) in non-test code. The gate MUST report a RUNTIME-FMT: file:line finding for each banned token and exit 1. Mirrors fixtures/removed-crate-residue/negative.md (13 lines). The first half of test_quarantine_gate_blocks_json_import.
test_impact: Used by test-forbid-runtime-fmt.sh [2/N] negative json/yaml/http fixture must FAIL assertion; also drives test_quarantine_gate_blocks_json_import.

description: Negative fixture: a Rust snippet containing `tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded_channel()` and `HashMap<String, _>` in non-test code. The gate MUST report a RUNTIME-FMT: file:line finding for each banned pattern and exit 1. Drives test_quarantine_gate_blocks_unbounded_channel.
test_impact: Used by test-forbid-runtime-fmt.sh [3/N] negative unbounded channel + HashMap<String,_> fixture must FAIL assertion; also drives test_quarantine_gate_blocks_unbounded_channel.

description: New Moon task file declaring the forbid-runtime-fmt task. Per the bead description canonical path. If implemented as a literal separate file, .moon.yml must be updated to add it to the `includes:` list (currently .moon.yml line 1-7 includes only all.yml, flux.yml, kani.yml, loom.yml, verus.yml, tlc.yml). Alternative: add the task as a new entry inside .moon/tasks/all.yml (modeled on check-removed-crate-residue at line 255-265 and hot-cold-forbidden-apis at line 633-645). The new task MUST be added as a deps: of the :check task in .moon/tasks/all.yml (modeled on hot-cold-forbidden-apis at line 117) to be ordered before the heavier compile gates. See OQ-001 in codebase-map.md section 7. The decision is owned by the holzman-rust / State 11 implementation agent.
test_impact: test_moon_ci_quarantine_dependency_correctly_ordered asserts the gate is declared and correctly ordered as a deps: of :check.

Modeled on .moon/tasks/all.yml::check-removed-feature-residue (line 267-277) for the script/inputs shape and .moon/tasks/all.yml::hot-cold-forbidden-apis (line 633-645) for the four-hot-crate inputs glob. description: First of the four hot crates under the gate's scope. The gate scans this path for serde_json|serde_yaml|hyper|reqwest|axum|HashMap<String,_>|tokio::sync::mpsc::unbounded in non-test code. Existing first-party deps: serde, thiserror, bytes, chrono, indexmap, postcard. vb_core has a serde_json dev-dep (Cargo.toml line 22) used only by tests/proptest_serde_roundtrip.rs, src/action/tests.rs, src/diagnostic/tests_and_verification.rs. The gate must NOT false-positive on these test code paths.
test_impact: The real-repo scan in test-forbid-runtime-fmt.sh [4/N] must pass on the current tree; the cold-markers allowlist must include the dev-dep test paths.

description: Third of the four hot crates under the gate's scope. Existing first-party deps: serde, thiserror, fjall, arrayvec, blake3, chrono, crc32c, rustix, postcard, vb_core, loom (optional), flux-rs (optional). No forbidden deps declared. description: Fourth of the four hot crates under the gate's scope. Existing first-party deps: serde, thiserror, arrayvec, byteorder, bytes, crossbeam-channel, crossbeam-queue, mio (net + os-poll), postcard, vb_core, vb_runtime. No forbidden deps declared. Master §19 Action ABI binary IPC lives here; the gate protects trigger 10 of master §43 ('IPC behavior if touched') by preventing introduction of hyper/reqwest/axum HTTP stacks or serde_json runtime codecs into the IPC path.

description: Master §43 AI Agent Acceptance Contract (lines 2027-2065) defines a 14-item reporting list and an automatic-rejection block. Triggers 7-10 of the reporting list are 'Allocation behavior' (line 2038), 'Hot-path behavior' (line 2039), 'Fjall persistence behavior if touched' (line 2040), 'IPC behavior if touched' (line 2041). The gate does not directly enforce these four triggers; it enforces their upstream constraints: master §2 'No JSON in the runtime core' / 'No HTTP in the runtime core' / 'No HashMap<String, Value> runtime state' (lines 99-102) and master §12 'Forbidden Hot-Path APIs' explicit list (lines 405-439) including serde_json, HashMap<String,_>, JSON parser calls, HTTP server/client calls, unbounded channel creation. Master §44.6 is the closest DoD pointer: 'JSON and HTTP are absent from vb_core, vb_runtime, vb_storage, and vb_ipc.' The gate is the mechanical enforcement layer for §44.6. Master line 6147 also lists `scripts/forbid-runtime-fmt.sh` as a Tier A acceptance-criteria gate, confirming the bead fills a pre-existing master spec gap.
test_impact: evidence-packaging State 14 must map each §2/§12/§43 trigger to a piece of evidence (scanner test output, moon-ci run output, scanner source link).
